applies_to: vision / grasp planning only (armctl.kin.fk_vision, kin.ik(corr=kin.vision_correction())). Commanded joint targets stay in DimOS joint space; envelope, table-clearance safety checks, choreography and DimOS itself use the nominal yam.urdf.
meaning: q_model = q_dimos + joint_offsets (rad). j1 and j6 offsets are unobservable from a fixed board (absorbed by the table pose and T_tip_cam) and stay 0; j2 is only weakly observable (needs a wide j1 spread) and is left 0.
systematic_note: d5 is the same in both datasets (-23.9 / -24.2 mrad); d4 moves -41 .. -55 mrad depending on whether d2/d3 are fitted and between datasets (-33 he1 / -55 he2): treat d4 as +-10 mrad.
